auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Zotero API key. Create a dedicated key and copy your user ID from https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys.

actions.name: create_collection
actions.description: Create one collection in a Zotero user or group library.

libraryType.description: The Zotero library type. Omit it to use the connected user's library.

libraryId.description: The numeric Zotero user or group library ID. User libraries default to the connected user's ID.

name.description: The name of the new Zotero collection.

anyOf.description: The key of the parent Zotero collection.
A false value indicating a root Zotero collection.

parentCollection.description: The parent collection key, or false for a root collection.

inputSchema.description: The input for creating one Zotero collection.

name.description: The display name of the Zotero library.

library.description: The Zotero library metadata attached to an item or collection.

links.description: The links returned for the Zotero collection.

meta.description: The computed metadata returned for the collection.

anyOf.description: The key of the parent Zotero collection.
A false value indicating a root Zotero collection.

parentCollection.description: The parent collection key, or false for a root collection.

collection.description: A Zotero collection resource with stable identity fields and provider-defined metadata.

anyOf.description: The Zotero library version assigned by the write, or null when absent.

libraryVersion.description: The Zotero library version assigned by the write, or null when absent.

links.description: The links returned for the Zotero item.

meta.description: The computed metadata returned for the Zotero item.

item.description: A Zotero item resource with stable identity fields and provider-defined metadata.

anyOf.description: The Zotero library version assigned by the write, or null when absent.

libraryVersion.description: The Zotero library version assigned by the write, or null when absent.

libraryId.description: The numeric Zotero user or group library ID. User libraries default to the connected user's ID.

actions.name: list_collections

libraryId.description: The numeric Zotero user or group library ID. User libraries default to the connected user's ID.

start.description: The zero-based index of the first object to return.

actions.name: update_item
actions.description: Partially update one Zotero item at a known version.

libraryType.description: The Zotero library type. Omit it to use the connected user's library.

libraryId.description: The numeric Zotero user or group library ID. User libraries default to the connected user's ID.

itemKey.description: The key of the Zotero item to update.

version.description: The current item version used for concurrency control.

changes.description: The editable Zotero fields to patch. Omitted properties remain unchanged; arrays replace the complete upstream list.

inputSchema.description: The input for partially updating one Zotero item.

itemKey.description: The key of the updated Zotero item.

updated.description: Whether Zotero accepted the item update.

anyOf.description: The Zotero item version assigned by the update, or null when absent.

libraryVersion.description: The Zotero item version assigned by the update, or null when absent.

outputSchema.description: The acknowledgement for an updated Zotero item.
